label: Edit
alt: Arya Edit page with a scene from Tears of Steel. The viewer shows two characters on a canal bridge with a selected TEARS OF STEEL title and a burned-in subtitle. Below, seven picture clips, linked dialogue with waveforms, a location card, an accent bar and two markers.
caption: Edit. Seven shots cut from two source files, a selected native title over the picture, linked dialogue on A1 and markers on the ruler.

label: Color
alt: Arya Color page grading a close-up of Celia. A serial node graph runs Input, Primary, a qualifier corrector, a window corrector and Output. An RGB parade sits above lift, gamma, gain, offset, shadows and highlights wheels, balance values and a curve.
caption: Color. A three-node grade on the close-up: primary balance, a skin qualifier and an inverted circle window, read on the RGB parade.

label: Motion
alt: Arya Motion page with the selected location card over a close-up of Thom. The layer list shows the card's transform properties with Position X and Opacity keyframes, and the inspector shows its transform values.
caption: Motion. The location card's Position X and Opacity keyframes in the layer timeline, beside its transform inspector.

label: Shorts
alt: Arya Edit page with a 1080 by 1920 composition open. The vertical frame shows Celia on the bridge with a burned-in caption. The Shorts panel offers source, length, clip count, a 9:16 format and the word highlight caption style. Position keyframes mark the reframe on the clip.
caption: Shorts. The bridge exchange as a 9:16 composition, reframed between the two speakers with Position X keyframes.
